description: Evidence-scoped Test262 conformance, readiness, current fixture status and historical diagnostics. Operational signals use explicit unknown states; notifications are paused.

options.content:
## Current conformance requires a reporting target and trusted evidence
Each result below is scoped to a channel, evidence kind and provenance. **Native** results measure the native implementation; **MVP composite** results measure the composite pipeline and are reported separately.

Pass rate = fixtures with all required variants passing ÷ runnable fixtures. Missing, conflicting and failing results remain in that denominator. Excluded fixtures are shown separately, so this is scoped runnable conformance, not a claim that the entire Test262 suite passes.

**No current rows means conformance has not yet been established.** Historical observations are diagnostic evidence, not a current conformance score. Counts describe stored evidence; archive import completion is a separate check. Panels use the current snapshot, independent of the time picker.

targets.rawSql:
WITH current_rows AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT channel,evidence_kind,provenance_id,corpus_id,fixture_id,upstream_path,status,eligibility,reason_codes,recorded_variant_count,pass_variant_count,conflict_flag,last_received_at,target_updated_at FROM test262_reporting.v_current_fixture_status WHERE repository_id IN (${repository:sqlstring})),
scope_rows AS (SELECT t.channel,t.evidence_kind,t.provenance_id,a.* FROM (SELECT channel,evidence_kind,provenance_id FROM test262_reporting.v_target_health WHERE repository_id IN (${repository:sqlstring})) t CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT min(corpus_id::text)::uuid AS corpus_id,count(*) AS inventory_fixtures,count(*) FILTER (WHERE eligibility='runnable' AND status <> 'metadata-error') AS runnable_fixtures,count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='complete-pass' AND eligibility='runnable') AS passing_fixtures,round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='complete-pass' AND eligibility='runnable') / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE eligibility='runnable' AND status <> 'metadata-error'),0),2) AS runnable_pass_percent,count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='fail') AS failing_fixtures,count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='incomplete') AS incomplete_fixtures,count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='conflicted') AS conflicted_fixtures,count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='excluded') AS excluded_fixtures,count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='metadata-error') AS metadata_errors,max(last_received_at) AS last_evidence_at,max(target_updated_at) AS target_updated_at FROM current_rows r WHERE r.channel=t.channel AND r.evidence_kind=t.evidence_kind AND r.provenance_id=t.provenance_id HAVING count(*)>0) a ORDER BY t.channel,t.evidence_kind),
status_rows AS (SELECT t.channel,t.evidence_kind,t.provenance_id,a.* FROM (SELECT channel,evidence_kind,provenance_id FROM test262_reporting.v_target_health WHERE repository_id IN (${repository:sqlstring})) t CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT status,count(*) AS fixtures FROM current_rows r WHERE r.channel=t.channel AND r.evidence_kind=t.evidence_kind AND r.provenance_id=t.provenance_id GROUP BY status) a ORDER BY t.channel,t.evidence_kind,status),
attention_selected AS (SELECT * FROM current_rows WHERE status IN ('fail','incomplete','conflicted','metadata-error') ORDER BY status,upstream_path LIMIT 500),
attention_rows AS (SELECT a.*,v.required_variant_count FROM attention_selected a CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT v.required_variant_count FROM test262_reporting.v_current_required_variants v WHERE v.channel=a.channel AND v.evidence_kind=a.evidence_kind AND v.provenance_id=a.provenance_id AND v.fixture_id=a.fixture_id OFFSET 0) v),
scope_count AS (SELECT count(*) AS scopes FROM (SELECT DISTINCT channel,evidence_kind,provenance_id FROM scope_rows) s)
SELECT 'scope'::text AS report_row,x.channel::text AS channel,x.evidence_kind::text AS evidence_kind,x.provenance_id::uuid AS provenance_id,x.corpus_id::uuid AS corpus_id,x.inventory_fixtures::bigint AS inventory_fixtures,x.runnable_fixtures::bigint AS runnable_fixtures,x.passing_fixtures::bigint AS passing_fixtures,x.runnable_pass_percent::numeric AS runnable_pass_percent,x.failing_fixtures::bigint AS failing_fixtures,x.incomplete_fixtures::bigint AS incomplete_fixtures,x.conflicted_fixtures::bigint AS conflicted_fixtures,x.excluded_fixtures::bigint AS excluded_fixtures,x.metadata_errors::bigint AS metadata_errors,x.last_evidence_at::timestamptz AS last_evidence_at,x.target_updated_at::timestamptz AS target_updated_at,NULL::text AS status,NULL::bigint AS fixtures,NULL::text AS upstream_path,NULL::text AS eligibility,NULL::text[] AS reason_codes,NULL::bigint AS required_variant_count,NULL::bigint AS recorded_variant_count,NULL::bigint AS pass_variant_count,NULL::boolean AS conflict_flag,NULL::timestamptz AS last_received_at,NULL::bigint AS scopes FROM scope_rows x
UNION ALL
SELECT 'status'::text AS report_row,x.channel::text AS channel,x.evidence_kind::text AS evidence_kind,x.provenance_id::uuid AS provenance_id,NULL::uuid AS corpus_id,NULL::bigint AS inventory_fixtures,NULL::bigint AS runnable_fixtures,NULL::bigint AS passing_fixtures,NULL::numeric AS runnable_pass_percent,NULL::bigint AS failing_fixtures,NULL::bigint AS incomplete_fixtures,NULL::bigint AS conflicted_fixtures,NULL::bigint AS excluded_fixtures,NULL::bigint AS metadata_errors,NULL::timestamptz AS last_evidence_at,NULL::timestamptz AS target_updated_at,x.status::text AS status,x.fixtures::bigint AS fixtures,NULL::text AS upstream_path,NULL::text AS eligibility,NULL::text[] AS reason_codes,NULL::bigint AS required_variant_count,NULL::bigint AS recorded_variant_count,NULL::bigint AS pass_variant_count,NULL::boolean AS conflict_flag,NULL::timestamptz AS last_received_at,NULL::bigint AS scopes FROM status_rows x
UNION ALL
SELECT 'attention'::text AS report_row,x.channel::text AS channel,x.evidence_kind::text AS evidence_kind,x.provenance_id::uuid AS provenance_id,NULL::uuid AS corpus_id,NULL::bigint AS inventory_fixtures,NULL::bigint AS runnable_fixtures,NULL::bigint AS passing_fixtures,NULL::numeric AS runnable_pass_percent,NULL::bigint AS failing_fixtures,NULL::bigint AS incomplete_fixtures,NULL::bigint AS conflicted_fixtures,NULL::bigint AS excluded_fixtures,NULL::bigint AS metadata_errors,NULL::timestamptz AS last_evidence_at,NULL::timestamptz AS target_updated_at,x.status::text AS status,NULL::bigint AS fixtures,x.upstream_path::text AS upstream_path,x.eligibility::text AS eligibility,x.reason_codes::text[] AS reason_codes,x.required_variant_count::bigint AS required_variant_count,x.recorded_variant_count::bigint AS recorded_variant_count,x.pass_variant_count::bigint AS pass_variant_count,x.conflict_flag::boolean AS conflict_flag,x.last_received_at::timestamptz AS last_received_at,NULL::bigint AS scopes FROM attention_rows x
UNION ALL
SELECT 'scope-count'::text AS report_row,NULL::text AS channel,NULL::text AS evidence_kind,NULL::uuid AS provenance_id,NULL::uuid AS corpus_id,NULL::bigint AS inventory_fixtures,NULL::bigint AS runnable_fixtures,NULL::bigint AS passing_fixtures,NULL::numeric AS runnable_pass_percent,NULL::bigint AS failing_fixtures,NULL::bigint AS incomplete_fixtures,NULL::bigint AS conflicted_fixtures,NULL::bigint AS excluded_fixtures,NULL::bigint AS metadata_errors,NULL::timestamptz AS last_evidence_at,NULL::timestamptz AS target_updated_at,NULL::text AS status,NULL::bigint AS fixtures,NULL::text AS upstream_path,NULL::text AS eligibility,NULL::text[] AS reason_codes,NULL::bigint AS required_variant_count,NULL::bigint AS recorded_variant_count,NULL::bigint AS pass_variant_count,NULL::boolean AS conflict_flag,NULL::timestamptz AS last_received_at,x.scopes::bigint AS scopes FROM scope_count x
